disagreement.independent_candidate: 684 MPa overlaps SAE 1040 and SAE 1050; using both UTS and the measured 190 HB favors SAE 1040, but does not certify the grade.

source_review.finding: The supplied appendix lists SAE 1040 and SAE 1050 around the computed strength but does not contain a SAE 1045 row.

declared_convention_sources.title: ASTM E140 — Standard Hardness Conversion Tables for Metals
declared_convention_sources.claim_used: Hardness scale conversions are approximate and material-specific; standardized indentation tests can have comparable reliability when correctly applied.

declared_convention_sources.title: ISO 18265:2013 — Metallic materials — Conversion of hardness values
declared_convention_sources.claim_used: Converted values are indicators and do not replace results measured by the required method.

review_reasoning: The source table gives 92 HRB=190 BHN and therefore sigma_UTS=3.6*190=684 MPa.
684 MPa belongs to both source appendix ranges: SAE 1040 at 620-775 MPa and SAE 1050 at 655-980 MPa, so UTS alone is non-unique.
The same appendix places 190 HB inside SAE 1040 at 183-262 HB and just below SAE 1050 at 192-321 HB; the combined classroom evidence therefore favors SAE 1040.
SAE 1045 is not a candidate row in the supplied appendix and is rejected as unsupported legacy output.

For the reading-method question, Rockwell uses residual penetration depth; Brinell and Vickers use optical indentation geometry. A universal accuracy ranking is not defensible without scale, material, surface, thickness and uncertainty conditions.
reviewed_exam_answer_ru: По одному σ_UTS однозначного выбора нет: диапазоны SAE 1040 и SAE 1050 перекрываются.
Если совместно использовать измеренные 190 HB и приложение, наиболее обоснованный ответ — SAE 1040; это учебная идентификация, не сертификат марки.
Rockwell считывает глубину, Brinell/Vickers — размер отпечатка; точность определяется правильностью выбранного метода и условиями, а не названием шкалы само по себе.
